arguments.description:
Client Project Tracking module for a professional services or consulting firm. Track client engagements from kickoff to closeout.

Core fields:
- Project name (text, required)
- Client (text or linked reference)
- Status (workflow state: Planning, In Progress, On Hold, Completed, Cancelled)
- Start date (date)
- Deadline (date)
- Owner (assigned user, responsible for delivery)
- Budget (currency/money)
- Optional: Description (long text), Notes (long text)

Lifecycle / states:
- Planning (initial, project scoped)
- In Progress (active work)
- On Hold (paused, can resume)
- Completed (delivered successfully)
- Cancelled (terminated)

Activities / transitions:
- Start Project: Planning → In Progress (owner)
- Put On Hold: In Progress → On Hold (owner)
- Resume: On Hold → In Progress (owner)
- Complete: In Progress → Completed (owner)
- Cancel: Planning/In Progress/On Hold → Cancelled (owner)
- Edit details: any state (owner)

Users who interact: Project Owner (primary), with admins able to edit/delete any project.
